request78.restore_contract: Copy the retained exact-byte parent78-original receipt to the original expected pathname, or git show the listed fixed commit/path/blob. Do not serialize the normalized JSON and pretend its byte hash is the original receipt.

historical_readers.other_workflows: Each selected receipt basename occurs once as a write in its own fully read original workflow. This is a scoped source fact, not a claim that no other historical audit ever reads the metadata. Any original byte reader must use the recorded original file bytes.

restoration.scientific_reproduction: Use each original actual command with the exact original workflow/source and listed inputs. Such a replay is not requested or required for this retention; the old numerical claims and failures remain those in their retained complete notes.
restoration.live_capacity: Only the explicitly listed generated metadata may be removed. New source/parameter packages remain excluded.
